name: agent-browser-clawdbot
description: Headless browser automation CLI optimized for AI agents with accessibility tree snapshots and ref-based element selection
descriptionZh: 专为AI智能体优化的无头浏览器自动化CLI，支持无障碍树快照和基于引用的元素选择。

en.tagline: Browser automation for AI agents using element refs
en.summary: This skill lets an AI agent drive a headless browser through the agent-browser CLI. It takes accessibility tree snapshots and selects elements by ref, such as @e2, so each action targets a known element. This makes multi-step browser workflows more predictable.
problem: AI agents working in a browser often have to guess which element to click or fill, and they must parse raw page markup to do it. Multi-step flows, complex single-page apps and logins that need to be reused add more steps where things can go wrong.

With this skill, the agent takes a snapshot that lists interactive elements with roles and names, then acts on refs from that list. It saves login state, keeps separate sessions apart, and waits for the page to settle before it reads results.
fit: Multi-step browser workflows that an agent must repeat reliably
Complex single-page apps where element selection is hard
Testing two or more user roles at the same time, each in its own session
Reusing a login by saving and loading cookies and storage
unfit: Tasks that need screenshots or PDFs for visual analysis, where the built-in browser tool is recommended
Visual inspection or browser extension integration
steps: Open a URL with `agent-browser open <url>` and take a snapshot with `agent-browser snapshot -i --json`.
Read the refs and their roles and names from the JSON output.
Act on an element by its ref, for example `agent-browser click @e2` or `agent-browser fill @e3 "text"`.
Wait for the page to settle with `agent-browser wait --load networkidle` or a text or URL condition.
Check the result with `get` and `is` commands, such as `agent-browser get text @e1 --json`.
Take a new snapshot after any page change, because refs must be read again.

zh.tagline: 面向 AI 智能体的无头浏览器自动化
zh.summary: 这个技能让 AI 智能体通过 agent-browser 命令行工具操作无头浏览器。它读取无障碍树快照，并通过 @e2 这类元素引用来选择页面元素，使每一步操作都指向确定的元素。这样，多步骤的浏览器流程更容易稳定复现。
problem: AI 智能体在浏览器中工作时，常常需要猜测该点击或填写哪个元素，还得自己解析原始页面标记。多步骤流程、复杂的单页应用，以及需要复用的登录状态，都会增加出错的环节。
使用这个技能后，智能体先获取快照，快照会列出带角色和名称的可交互元素，然后根据列表中的引用执行操作。它可以保存登录状态，把不同会话隔开，并在读取结果前等待页面稳定。
fit: 智能体需要可靠重复执行的多步骤浏览器流程
元素选择较难的复杂单页应用
需要同时测试两个或以上用户角色，每个角色使用独立会话
通过保存和加载 Cookie 与存储来复用登录状态
unfit: 需要截图或 PDF 做视觉分析的任务，此时建议使用内置浏览器工具
视觉检查或浏览器扩展集成
steps: 使用 `agent-browser open <url>` 打开网址，再用 `agent-browser snapshot -i --json` 获取快照。
从 JSON 输出中读取引用，以及每个引用对应的角色和名称。
通过元素引用执行操作，例如 `agent-browser click @e2` 或 `agent-browser fill @e3 "text"`。
用 `agent-browser wait --load networkidle` 或文本、网址条件等待页面稳定。
使用 `get` 和 `is` 类命令检查结果，例如 `agent-browser get text @e1 --json`。
页面发生变化后重新获取快照，因为需要重新读取引用。
